notes.title: Network Movement & UI Fixes
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed network synchronization issues that occasionally caused player movement desync during matches
[*] Resolved display problems where role cards would sometimes fail to appear correctly or show incomplete information
[/list]

notes.title: New Hunter Role Update
notes.content: [p][b]NEW: Hunter Role[/b] When the Hunter is about to be killed, they can shoot one player right before dying.[/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed pointing hand positioning[/p][/*][*][p]Minor gameplay improvements[/p][/*][/list][p]Try out the new Hunter role and get your revenge![/p]

notes.title: Major Network Fixes & Jester Rework
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed the major networking issues that were affecting multiplayer stability.[/p][/*][*][p]Jester role has been completely reworked - instead of voting and hiding, Jesters now throw bombs.[/p][/*][*][p]Voting has been improved with automatic tie-breakers. During night phases, tied team votes now select a random target instead of resulting in no action.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Team Voice Added and More!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added team voice channels for Impostors and Investigators
[*] Balanced Nurse role: reduced to 4 injections
[*] Other small improvements 
[/list]

notes.title: Nurse Injection Fix & Time Options Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Nurse Bug Fix: Resolved an issue where the target could sometimes die from the first injection. The mechanic now works as intended—targets will only die on the second injection if not healed beforehand
[*] Added new time options for day/night cycles (600s and 240s) for more longer session lengths
[*] Various minor improvements and optimizations
[/list]

notes.title: New Update: "Show Roles After Death" Option + Game Settings Popup!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Just released a new update based on your feedback:

New Setting: You can now toggle "Show Roles After Death".  Want more mystery after players are eliminated? Disable this option in the game settings.

Improved Game Summary: You can now view match settings by opening the game summary popup (press TAB)

notes.title: Jester Hide Fix
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the Jester’s hide ability wasn’t working as intended. It should now function properly during gameplay.

notes.title: Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed character selection during voting (sometimes it didn’t work properly)
[*] Visually improved Jester’s hide ability
[*] Fixed lobby lighting not resetting after game over
[/list]

notes.title: Role Balance Update (Default Deck)
notes.content:
The default role setup has been rebalanced—Jester is now only included by default in games with 12 or more players.
You can still manually add Jester in smaller matches if you’d like—this only affects the Generate Default button.

notes.title: Launch Update: New Release Date – April 19
notes.content:
Hello everyone,​

We want to inform you that our game's release has been delayed by two days. The new release date is April 19, 2025.​

We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your patience and support.​

Thank you for your understanding.
